mapper.select:
select si.id, si.code, si.name, si.`space`, si.create_date, si.images, si.lot_id, si.price,
pi.lot_name, pi.address, pi.lot_type from space_info si left join park_info pi on (pi.lot_id = si.lot_id) where 1 = 1
AND si.code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{spaceInfo.code},'%')
AND si.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{spaceInfo.name},'%')
order by si.create_date desc

select si.id, si.code, si.name, si.`space`, si.create_date, si.images, si.lot_id, si.price,
pi.lot_name, pi.address, pi.lot_type from space_info si left join space_status_info ssi on (ssi.space_id = si.id) left join park_info pi on (pi.lot_id = si.lot_id) where 1 = 1 and ssi.status = '0' order by create_date desc
